s0001.literal: Third year of Zhishun, spring, first month, on xinwei new moon, the King of Goryeo Zhen dispatched his minister Yuanzhong to present a memorial offering congratulations and tribute goods.
s0001.idiomatic: Third year of Zhishun, spring, first month, on xinwei new moon, the King of Goryeo Zhen dispatched his minister Yuanzhong to present a memorial offering congratulations and tribute goods.

s0002.literal: On guiyou day, the King of Goryeo Wang Chon was ordered to remain King of Goryeo; a gold seal was granted.
s0002.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the King of Goryeo Wang Chon was ordered to remain King of Goryeo; a gold seal was granted.

s0003.literal: Previously Chon had been ill and ordered his son Zhen to succeed to the kingly title; now Chon's illness had healed, so he resumed the position.
s0003.idiomatic: Previously Chon had been ill and ordered his son Zhen to succeed to the kingly title; now Chon's illness had healed, so he resumed the position.

s0004.literal: On jiaxu day, Yan Temür's wife Princess Yuelu was granted five hundred taels of gold and five thousand taels of silver.
s0004.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Yan Temür's wife Princess Yuelu was granted 500 taels of gold and 5,000 taels of silver.

s0005.literal: On dingchou day, those who falsely pleaded for restoration of office were forbidden.
s0005.idiomatic: On dingchou day, those who falsely pleaded for restoration of office were forbidden.

s0006.literal: Fifty thousand shi of grain was sold in relief to aid the capital's poor.
s0006.idiomatic: 50,000 shi of grain was sold in relief to aid the capital's poor.

s0007.literal: On jimao day, the seasonal offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0007.idiomatic: On jimao day, the seasonal offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0008.literal: All construction labor corvée was halted; only city walls, rivers and canals, bridges and roads, and warehouses were not forbidden.
s0008.idiomatic: All construction labor corvée was halted; only city walls, rivers and canals, bridges and roads, and warehouses were not forbidden.

s0009.literal: Ma Wuchong and other rebel bandits of Luowei in Guangxi, together with Wei Dachong's bandit troops of Langlong Cave north of Longzhou Ridge — ten thousand men — attacked and seized the stockades of Nama Wei, Nama'an, and others; the Guangxi Pacification Commission was ordered to deploy troops strictly to defend.
s0009.idiomatic: Ma Wuchong and other rebel bandits of Luowei in Guangxi, together with Wei Dachong's bandit troops of Langlong Cave north of Longzhou Ridge — 10,000 men — attacked and seized the stockades of Nama Wei, Nama'an, and others; the Guangxi Pacification Commission was ordered to deploy troops strictly to defend.

s0010.literal: Yuekuochär falsely requested garrison fodder bundles; he should have been punished by law, but Yan Temür requested his release.
s0010.idiomatic: Yuekuochär falsely requested garrison fodder bundles; he should have been punished by law, but Yan Temür requested his release.

s0011.literal: On renwu day, Gansu Branch Secretariat was ordered to build a residence for Prince of Bin Buyan Temür.
s0011.idiomatic: On renwu day, Gansu Branch Secretariat was ordered to build a residence for Prince of Bin Buyan Temür.

s0012.literal: Confucius's wife, Lady of Yun State Jiguan Shi, was enfeoffed as consort of the Great Accomplished Ultimate Sage Literary Propagation King.
s0012.idiomatic: Confucius's wife, Lady of Yun State Jiguan Shi, was enfeoffed as consort of the Great Accomplished Ultimate Sage Literary Propagation King.

s0013.literal: On guiwei day, grain and fodder were issued to fourteen relays including Nalin.
s0013.idiomatic: On guiwei day, grain and fodder were issued to 14 relays including Nalin.

s0014.literal: Yongchang Route famine refugees were relieved.
s0014.idiomatic: Yongchang Route famine refugees were relieved.

s0015.literal: Nan Dan and other streams-and-caves Military-Civilian Pacification Commission of Qingyuan said: subordinate Yishan County suffered famine and pestilence; many died; requested using two hundred eighty shi of grain accumulated for army rations to sell in relief — approved.
s0015.idiomatic: Nan Dan and other streams-and-caves Military-Civilian Pacification Commission of Qingyuan said: subordinate Yishan County suffered famine and pestilence; many died; requested using 280 shi of grain accumulated for army rations to sell in relief — approved.

s0016.literal: Jiangxi Branch Secretariat said: Meizhou had floods and droughts several years running; the people suffered great famine; ordered to issue seven hundred shi of grain to sell in relief.
s0016.idiomatic: Jiangxi Branch Secretariat said: Meizhou had floods and droughts several years running; the people suffered great famine; ordered to issue 700 shi of grain to sell in relief.

s0017.literal: On bingxu day, the year's quota of note reserves was printed — Zhiyuan notes nine hundred ninety-six thousand ingots, Zhongtong notes four thousand ingots.
s0017.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the year's quota of note reserves was printed — Zhiyuan notes 996,000 ingots, Zhongtong notes 4,000 ingots.

s0018.literal: On dinghai day, the Emperor visited the Great Cheng Tian Protecting the Sagely Monastery.
s0018.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor visited the Great Cheng Tian Protecting the Sagely Monastery.

s0019.literal: Prince Temür and his consort Arigh Bari were each granted five hundred taels of gold, ten thousand taels of silver, twenty thousand ingots of notes, and one thousand bolts each of silks and brocades.
s0019.idiomatic: Prince Temür and his consort Arigh Bari were each granted 500 taels of gold, 10,000 taels of silver, 20,000 ingots of notes, and 1,000 bolts each of silks and brocades.

s0020.literal: Surveillance censor memorialized: "Hanlin Academy academician-director Dianha — his elder brother Yeliya was executed for a crime; he should be dismissed."
s0020.idiomatic: Surveillance censor memorialized: "Hanlin Academy academician-director Dianha — his elder brother Yeliya was executed for a crime; he should be dismissed."

s0022.literal: On wuzi day, Li bandit Wang Nuluo of Wan'an Army and others gathered fifty thousand men and raided Lingshui County.
s0022.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Li bandit Wang Nuluo of Wan'an Army and others gathered 50,000 men and raided Lingshui County.

s0023.literal: On jichou day, nine thousand five hundred forty mouths among the famine refugees of Gaoyao County, Zhaoqing Route were relieved.
s0023.idiomatic: On jichou day, 9,540 mouths among the famine refugees of Gaoyao County, Zhaoqing Route were relieved.

s0024.literal: Sichuan Branch Secretariat said: "Last year in the ninth month, Associate Administrator Toqtemür Buqa fought the rebel troops of Luchu and was wounded; the bandits then invaded the borders; requested dispatching two thousand five hundred troops from Chongqing and Xuzhou to rescue."
s0024.idiomatic: Sichuan Branch Secretariat said: "Last year in the 9th month, Associate Administrator Toqtemür Buqa fought the rebel troops of Luchu and was wounded; the bandits then invaded the borders; requested dispatching 2,500 troops from Chongqing and Xuzhou to rescue."

s0025.literal: Shunyuan Pacification Commission also said: "The bandits arrayed camps in sixteen places; requested dispatching troops by separate routes to defend."
s0025.idiomatic: Shunyuan Pacification Commission also said: "The bandits arrayed camps in 16 places; requested dispatching troops by separate routes to defend."

s0026.literal: An edict ordered the Shangdu Defender's Office to build a residence for Yan Temür.
s0026.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Shangdu Defender's Office to build a residence for Yan Temür.

s0027.literal: Censorate said: "Those selected and appointed to Yunnan Surveillance Office, many use excuses and do not take up office; hereafter if there are such persons, the surveillance authorities must not employ them again."
s0027.idiomatic: Censorate said: "Those selected and appointed to Yunnan Surveillance Office, many use excuses and do not take up office; hereafter if there are such persons, the surveillance authorities must not employ them again."

s0029.literal: On wuxu day, the central secretariat was ordered with three thousand ingots of notes and three thousand bolts each of silks and brocades for Prince Guna Nadala's annual allotment for hawking and hunting return gifts.
s0029.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the central secretariat was ordered with 3,000 ingots of notes and 3,000 bolts each of silks and brocades for Prince Guna Nadala's annual allotment for hawking and hunting return gifts.

s0030.literal: Prince Zhangji presented one hundred seventy Oros people; rewarded with seventy-two ingots of silver and five thousand ingots of notes.
s0030.idiomatic: Prince Zhangji presented 170 Oros people; rewarded with 72 ingots of silver and 5,000 ingots of notes.

s0031.literal: On jihai day, clothing and provisions were issued to one thousand Oros people.
s0031.idiomatic: On jihai day, clothing and provisions were issued to 1,000 Oros people.

s0032.literal: Southern Mountains Circuit associate surveillance commissioner Tuojian Dong'a impeached: "Huguang North Route pacification commissioner Bielieqiedu once borrowed notes from the inner treasury, coerced district people to repay on his behalf, and when insufficient used the pacification commissioner's public funds to repay."
s0032.idiomatic: Southern Mountains Circuit associate surveillance commissioner Tuojian Dong'a impeached: "Huguang North Route pacification commissioner Bielieqiedu once borrowed notes from the inner treasury, coerced district people to repay on his behalf, and when insufficient used the pacification commissioner's public funds to repay."

s0033.literal: "Also, associate commissioner Lüju, repairing the river-bank dikes along the Yangzi, let household slaves extort people's wealth."
s0033.idiomatic: "Also, associate commissioner Lüju, repairing the river-bank dikes along the Yangzi, let household slaves extort people's wealth."

s0034.literal: "Though the two men's crimes met amnesty, they should still be dismissed and expelled."
s0034.idiomatic: "Though the 2 men's crimes met amnesty, they should still be dismissed and expelled."

s0036.literal: On gengzi day, Princess Buna was enfeoffed Grand Princess of Yun'an.
s0036.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Princess Buna was enfeoffed Grand Princess of Yun'an.

s0037.literal: Dongzhai stockade cave chief of Kuizhou Aju Shiyong, together with more than eight hundred cave barbarians, raided Shizhou.
s0037.idiomatic: Dongzhai stockade cave chief of Kuizhou Aju Shiyong, together with more than 800 cave barbarians, raided Shizhou.

s0038.literal: Second month, on xinchou new moon, Ba-Fan Miao barbarian Luodu came to present tribute goods.
s0038.idiomatic: Second month, on xinchou new moon, Ba-Fan Miao barbarian Luodu came to present tribute goods.

s0039.literal: On guimao day, Prince Yisun Temür died.
s0039.idiomatic: On guimao day, Prince Yisun Temür died.

s0040.literal: On jiachen day, Princes Darimashi and Harman each dispatched envoys presenting grape wine, western horses, and gold hawk-and-falcon.
s0040.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Princes Darimashi and Harman each dispatched envoys presenting grape wine, western horses, and gold hawk-and-falcon.

s0041.literal: On yisi day, Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Yuelu Buhua was made Shaanxi Branch Censorate censor-in-chief.
s0041.idiomatic: On yisi day, Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Yuelu Buhua was made Shaanxi Branch Censorate censor-in-chief.

s0042.literal: Stipends were issued to the Prince of Bin and his prince's tutor.
s0042.idiomatic: Stipends were issued to the Prince of Bin and his prince's tutor.

s0043.literal: On wushen day, Yunnan Branch Secretariat said: "Tongzhou local official Ase and Heli of Hexi and others, together with one thousand five hundred Luoluo bandit troops, raided Bulong Village in Huizhou Route;
s0043.idiomatic: On wushen day, Yunnan Branch Secretariat said: "Tongzhou local official Ase and Heli of Hexi and others, together with 1,500 Luoluo bandit troops, raided Bulong Village in Huizhou Route;

s0044.literal: "Also, Luchu will lead troops to join Mangbu in raiding Luoluo, cutting off the Dadu River and Jinsha River to attack Dongchuan, Huitong, and other prefectures.
s0044.idiomatic: "Also, Luchu will lead troops to join Mangbu in raiding Luoluo, cutting off the Dadu River and Jinsha River to attack Dongchuan, Huitong, and other prefectures.

s0045.literal: "We dare follow the earlier imperial edict to summon and instruct them; if they do not obey commands, we will advance troops as circumstances require."
s0045.idiomatic: "We dare follow the earlier imperial edict to summon and instruct them; if they do not obey commands, we will advance troops as circumstances require."

s0047.literal: On jiyou day, keshig officer Wanzhe Temür and Ashir were granted pearl hats and robes.
s0047.idiomatic: On jiyou day, keshig officer Wanzhe Temür and Ashir were granted pearl hats and robes.

s0048.literal: Deling Route last year had drought; again suffered frost and hail; the people hungered; three thousand shi of grain relieved them.
s0048.idiomatic: Deling Route last year had drought; again suffered frost and hail; the people hungered; 3,000 shi of grain relieved them.

s0049.literal: Zhang, wife of Liu Wei of Qin Prefecture, Jining Route, was honored for steadfast integrity.
s0049.idiomatic: Zhang, wife of Liu Wei of Qin Prefecture, Jining Route, was honored for steadfast integrity.

s0050.literal: Luchu said to Sichuan Branch Secretariat: "From fathers and grandfathers our house for generations has been Wusa native-official pacification commissioner, wearing the tiger tally, never with wayward intent.
s0050.idiomatic: Luchu said to Sichuan Branch Secretariat: "From fathers and grandfathers our house for generations has been Wusa native-official pacification commissioner, wearing the tiger tally, never with wayward intent.

s0051.literal: "Formerly coerced by Boqu; hearing the court's summons and instruction, but now the deadline has passed; beg another edict of amnesty; then immediately leading the four-route native officials to come forth and submit.
s0051.idiomatic: "Formerly coerced by Boqu; hearing the court's summons and instruction, but now the deadline has passed; beg another edict of amnesty; then immediately leading the 4-route native officials to come forth and submit.

s0052.literal: "Still beg to be reassigned subordinate to Sichuan Province, attached to Yongning Route, hoping to obtain rest."
s0052.idiomatic: "Still beg to be reassigned subordinate to Sichuan Province, attached to Yongning Route, hoping to obtain rest."

s0053.literal: Sichuan Branch Secretariat reported; an edict ordered the secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and other major officials to deliberate jointly.
s0053.idiomatic: Sichuan Branch Secretariat reported; an edict ordered the secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and other major officials to deliberate jointly.

s0054.literal: On jiwei day, Zhao Nahai of Ningxia Route was honored for filial conduct.
s0054.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Zhao Nahai of Ningxia Route was honored for filial conduct.

s0055.literal: On xinyou day, Yan Temür was made concurrent grand academician of the Kui Zhang Pavilion, taking charge of Kui Zhang Academy affairs.
s0055.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Yan Temür was made concurrent grand academician of the Kui Zhang Pavilion, taking charge of Kui Zhang Academy affairs.

s0056.literal: On jisi day, Yan Temür was ordered to gather the Hanlin, Imperial Archives, and Taixi Zongyin Court to deliberate establishing the Taizu spirit hall.
s0056.idiomatic: On jisi day, Yan Temür was ordered to gather the Hanlin, Imperial Archives, and Taixi Zongyin Court to deliberate establishing the Taizu spirit hall.

s0057.literal: An edict ordered repair of the Sagely Temple of Confucius at Qufu.
s0057.idiomatic: An edict ordered repair of the Sagely Temple of Confucius at Qufu.

s0058.literal: Qiongzhou had two wells — Song-era names Jinfeng and Maoci — at the start of Tianli, in the ninth month an earthquake caused salt water to surge; the prefectural subject Hou Kun wished to make utensils to boil salt and pay tax to the government; ordered Sichuan Salt Transport Office to oversee it.
s0058.idiomatic: Qiongzhou had 2 wells — Song-era names Jinfeng and Maoci — at the start of Tianli, in the 9th month an earthquake caused salt water to surge; the prefectural subject Hou Kun wished to make utensils to boil salt and pay tax to the government; ordered Sichuan Salt Transport Office to oversee it.

s0059.literal: Qin, wife of Wang De of Ren County, Jizhou; Song, wife of Wu Kan of Jinhua County, Wuzhou Route; Zhang, wife of Gao of Luzhou Route; Shalin, wife of Yuehunan of Ganzhou Route; Li, wife of Wanyan Tiego's household in Gaizhou — all honored for steadfast integrity.
s0059.idiomatic: Qin, wife of Wang De of Ren County, Jizhou; Song, wife of Wu Kan of Jinhua County, Wuzhou Route; Zhang, wife of Gao of Luzhou Route; Shalin, wife of Yuehunan of Ganzhou Route; Li, wife of Wanyan Tiego's household in Gaizhou — all honored for steadfast integrity.

s0060.literal: Third month, on gengwu new moon, the Imperial Preceptor arrived at the capital.
s0060.idiomatic: Third month, on gengwu new moon, the Imperial Preceptor arrived at the capital.

s0061.literal: Envoys were dispatched to the Western Regions to grant two hundred forty bolts of embroidered silks and brocades to Prince Busain.
s0061.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to the Western Regions to grant 240 bolts of embroidered silks and brocades to Prince Busain.

s0062.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "All distant-garrison military officers who die and return for burial should, following the civil-official precedent, be granted travel expenses.
s0062.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "All distant-garrison military officers who die and return for burial should, following the civil-official precedent, be granted travel expenses.

s0063.literal: "Also, Sichuan relay households lately have been depleted by military campaigns; officials should be dispatched together with the branch secretariat to measure and relieve them."
s0063.idiomatic: "Also, Sichuan relay households lately have been depleted by military campaigns; officials should be dispatched together with the branch secretariat to measure and relieve them."

s0065.literal: Yan Temür said: "Pingjiang and Songjiang polder fields at Dianshan Lake total somewhat more than five hundred qing; they should render seven thousand seven hundred shi of official grain to the state; the chief tenant died and many have been occupied for cultivation.
s0065.idiomatic: Yan Temür said: "Pingjiang and Songjiang polder fields at Dianshan Lake total somewhat more than 500 qing; they should render 7,700 shi of official grain to the state; the chief tenant died and many have been occupied for cultivation.

s0066.literal: "Now your subject wishes to increase the grain rendered to ten thousand shi for the state, have people tenant-cultivate, and use the surplus rice obtained to support your subject's younger brother Sadun."
s0066.idiomatic: "Now your subject wishes to increase the grain rendered to 10,000 shi for the state, have people tenant-cultivate, and use the surplus rice obtained to support your subject's younger brother Sadun."

s0069.literal: Java dispatched its ministers Sanggala and eighty-three others bearing a gold-ink memorial and tribute goods to court.
s0069.idiomatic: Java dispatched its ministers Sanggala and 83 others bearing a gold-ink memorial and tribute goods to court.

s0070.literal: On jimao day, an edict: "Because Prince of Xining Södem had meritorious service in frontier defense, following Prince of Anding Dorjiban's precedent, four prince-tutor posts were established and seals cast and granted."
s0070.idiomatic: On jimao day, an edict: "Because Prince of Xining Södem had meritorious service in frontier defense, following Prince of Anding Dorjiban's precedent, 4 prince-tutor posts were established and seals cast and granted."

s0071.literal: On gengchen day, Anlu Prefecture was granted as enfeoffment fief to Prince of Bing Huanghuotiemuer.
s0071.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Anlu Prefecture was granted as enfeoffment fief to Prince of Bing Huanghuotiemuer.

s0072.literal: Zhang, wife of Wei An of Liang Township, Dadu, was honored for chastity.
s0072.idiomatic: Zhang, wife of Wei An of Liang Township, Dadu, was honored for chastity.

s0073.literal: On dinghai day, Princes Buryau and Wanzhe Temür came to court.
s0073.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Princes Buryau and Wanzhe Temür came to court.

s0074.literal: On wuzi day, Champa dispatched its ministers Anan Nanalisha and four others bearing a gold-ink memorial and tribute goods to court.
s0074.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Champa dispatched its ministers Anan Nanalisha and 4 others bearing a gold-ink memorial and tribute goods to court.

s0075.literal: On jichou day, the Merit Commissionerate was re-established.
s0075.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Merit Commissionerate was re-established.

s0076.literal: On guisi day, Prince Guna Nadala was renamed Yan Tegus.
s0076.idiomatic: On guisi day, Prince Guna Nadala was renamed Yan Tegus.

s0077.literal: Xingrui Office was established to oversee inner-palace annual Buddhist rites — rank 3a.
s0077.idiomatic: Xingrui Office was established to oversee inner-palace annual Buddhist rites — rank 3a.

s0078.literal: On yiwei day, Yan Temür was ordered per the old precedent to divide ten thousand ingots of notes among Mongol orphans and widows.
s0078.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Yan Temür was ordered per the old precedent to divide 10,000 ingots of notes among Mongol orphans and widows.

s0079.literal: Because the Imperial Preceptor boated on the Gaoliang River west of the hills, three hundred garrison guardsmen were mobilized to tow the boat.
s0079.idiomatic: Because the Imperial Preceptor boated on the Gaoliang River west of the hills, 300 garrison guardsmen were mobilized to tow the boat.

s0080.literal: On bingshen day, keshig officer Zhuling Temür was granted an imperial patent and admonished regarding his subordinates.
s0080.idiomatic: On bingshen day, keshig officer Zhuling Temür was granted an imperial patent and admonished regarding his subordinates.

s0081.literal: Four hundred fifty-two households among the poor at nine relays including Mulin, Kuyanbo, Zhaha, and Saolin were relieved.
s0081.idiomatic: 452 households among the poor at 9 relays including Mulin, Kuyanbo, Zhaha, and Saolin were relieved.

s0082.literal: On dingyou day, Burma dispatched envoy Aluo and ten others presenting tribute goods to court.
s0082.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Burma dispatched envoy Aluo and 10 others presenting tribute goods to court.

s0083.literal: On jihai day, four hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted to the Mobile Privy Council to divide among Shaanxi and Sichuan Mongol troops and gradually enrolled troops mobilized for Wusa and Wumeng — ten thousand men.
s0083.idiomatic: On jihai day, 400,000 ingots of notes were granted to the Mobile Privy Council to divide among Shaanxi and Sichuan Mongol troops and gradually enrolled troops mobilized for Wusa and Wumeng — 10,000 men.

s0084.literal: Gaotang, De, and Ji prefectures; Daming, Bianliang, and Guangping routes — worms ate mulberry leaves bare.
s0084.idiomatic: Gaotang, De, and Ji prefectures; Daming, Bianliang, and Guangping routes — worms ate mulberry leaves bare.

s0085.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renyin day, central secretariat officials said: "Last year palace guard soldiers granted notes numbered fifteen thousand; now reduced by one thousand four hundred; the remainder to be granted numbers thirteen thousand six hundred.
s0085.idiomatic: Summer, 4th month, on renyin day, central secretariat officials said: "Last year palace guard soldiers granted notes numbered 15,000; now reduced by 1,400; the remainder to be granted numbers 13,600.

s0086.literal: "Also, the Imperial Stores Directorate yearly disburses twenty thousand bolts of silks and brocades, insufficient for use; requested another two hundred bolts."
s0086.idiomatic: "Also, the Imperial Stores Directorate yearly disburses 20,000 bolts of silks and brocades, insufficient for use; requested another 200 bolts."

s0088.literal: Twenty-three people including Yewang of Sanmao, Pansu, and Shibi's three-cave barbarians of Sichuan came to present tribute goods.
s0088.idiomatic: 23 people including Yewang of Sanmao, Pansu, and Shibi's 3-cave barbarians of Sichuan came to present tribute goods.

s0089.literal: On wushen day, Daning Route had an earthquake.
s0089.idiomatic: On wushen day, Daning Route had an earthquake.

s0090.literal: Fourteen people including Shiyong, masterminds of the Dapan Cave of Sichuan, came to present tribute goods.
s0090.idiomatic: 14 people including Shiyong, masterminds of the Dapan Cave of Sichuan, came to present tribute goods.

s0091.literal: On bingchen day, Prince Bupatupalan Falang dispatched envoy Yaohunan and others; envoys of Western Regions Prince Busain including Yisun Temür — all came to present tribute goods.
s0091.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Prince Bupatupalan Falang dispatched envoy Yaohunan and others; envoys of Western Regions Prince Busain including Yisun Temür — all came to present tribute goods.

s0092.literal: On wuwu day, the Kui Zhang Academy was ordered to translate the 《Essentials of Governance from the Zhenguan Reign》 into the national script, silver-plate block-print, and grant to the hundred officials.
s0092.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Kui Zhang Academy was ordered to translate the 《Essentials of Governance from the Zhenguan Reign》 into the national script, silver-plate block-print, and grant to the 100 officials.

s0093.literal: Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Wang Shouchang resigned — not permitted.
s0093.idiomatic: Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Wang Shouchang resigned — not permitted.

s0094.literal: To perform Buddhist rites praying for blessings, the censorate's imprisoned Dingxing County magistrate and twenty-six Ministry of Justice prisoners were released.
s0094.idiomatic: To perform Buddhist rites praying for blessings, the censorate's imprisoned Dingxing County magistrate and 26 Ministry of Justice prisoners were released.

s0095.literal: On yichou day, Annam heir Chen Rifu dispatched his ministers Deng Shiyan and twenty-four others to present tribute goods.
s0095.idiomatic: On yichou day, Annam heir Chen Rifu dispatched his ministers Deng Shiyan and 24 others to present tribute goods.

s0096.literal: Anxi Prince Ananda's son Yuelu Temür — on charges of plotting sedition with Uighur monk Uni Dabadraba and National Preceptor Bilate Nashiri Shajin Aihu Chi — princes and major officials jointly tried the case; when the case was complete all three were executed; their households were still registered and confiscated.
s0096.idiomatic: Anxi Prince Ananda's son Yuelu Temür — on charges of plotting sedition with Uighur monk Uni Dabadraba and National Preceptor Bilate Nashiri Shajin Aihu Chi — princes and major officials jointly tried the case; when the case was complete all 3 were executed; their households were still registered and confiscated.

s0097.literal: Bilate Nashiri Shajin Aihu Chi's wife Chouchou was granted to vice commissioner of transmissions Bolan; jade saddle granted to Sadun; remaining livestock, field estates, and seven-jewel trousseau, gold pearls, gems, notes, and silk currency — all confiscated into the Great Cheng Tian Protecting the Sagely Monastery.
s0097.idiomatic: Bilate Nashiri Shajin Aihu Chi's wife Chouchou was granted to vice commissioner of transmissions Bolan; jade saddle granted to Sadun; remaining livestock, field estates, and 7-jewel trousseau, gold pearls, gems, notes, and silk currency — all confiscated into the Great Cheng Tian Protecting the Sagely Monastery.

s0098.literal: This year's rents within Sichuan Branch Secretariat territory were remitted.
s0098.idiomatic: This year's rents within Sichuan Branch Secretariat territory were remitted.

s0099.literal: Ordered relevant offices to build a living shrine for Bayan, erect a merit monument at Zhuozhou; separately build shrine and monument at Bianliang.
s0099.idiomatic: Ordered relevant offices to build a living shrine for Bayan, erect a merit monument at Zhuozhou; separately build shrine and monument at Bianliang.

s0100.literal: On wuchen day, Yunnan Branch Secretariat land tax was remitted for three years.
s0100.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Yunnan Branch Secretariat land tax was remitted for 3 years.
